description: This file defines an abstract base class `BaseTextFilter` for text filtering components within the Pipecat framework. It provides interface methods for updating settings, applying filters, and handling interruptions, which must be implemented by subclasses.

classes.name: BaseTextFilter
classes.description: An abstract base class for text filters that modify text content in a processing pipeline, supporting settings updates and interruption handling.

methods.name: update_settings(self, settings: Mapping[str, Any])
methods.description: Asynchronously updates the filter's configuration settings. Subclasses should implement this to handle dynamic configuration updates.

methods.name: str filter(self, text: str)
methods.description: An abstract method that must be implemented by subclasses to apply specific filtering logic to input text.

methods.name: handle_interruption(self)
methods.description: Handle an interruption during processing, allowing subclasses to reset internal state.

methods.name: reset_interruption(self)
methods.description: Reset the filter state after an interruption has been handled, restoring normal operation.

ctags.name: filter
ctags.pattern: /^    async def filter(self, text: str) -> str:$/

ctags.name: update_settings
ctags.pattern: /^    async def update_settings(self, settings: Mapping[str, Any]):$/
